name: FP Range Conventional Fire Panel 2 Zone
family: Context Plus FP Range Conventional Panels - 1 to 14 Zone
summary: 2 Zone FP fire panel Non Expandable complete with 2 x 1.2A/H Sealed Lead Acid batteries).*
features: Two Zone Conventional fire panel. Two conventional Zone circuit.
Robust metal enclosure c/w lift off lid & heavy-duty base connections.
Separate indicators for open & short circuit fault, sounder fault and battery/power supply fault.
Non-latching class change sounder output, latching fire & non-latching fault outputs (via optional expansion loom).
Short circuit=fire facility (no resistors in call points, selectable on a zone by zone basis).
Compatible with virtually all known conventional fire detectors.
Ancillary connections for repeaters and other system add-ons including fault relay modules, fire relay modules, sounder delay relay modules, sounder extender kits, etc).
